class: Sibling section headings are lost before contextual field resolution
symptom: After disability status was answered, its required Date textbox remained blank and the run stopped for review. The field had MM/DD/YYYY placeholder and name eeo[disabilitySignatureDate].
root_cause: The parser retained ancestor groups and nearby labels but not the heading scope of sibling controls. The existing self-identification date rule therefore received a bare Date with empty container/context. The original first-page snapshot preceded the conditional date field; the later local capture showed its complete section.
why_tests_missed: Date tests exercised explicit date labels or directly supplied context, rather than headings followed by explanatory subheadings and sibling name/date fields.
fix: Track heading hierarchy separately on Control.section without changing question/group identity. Bound it by containing indentation, peer headings and separators. Let the existing contextual self-identification date rule use this scope and the existing date formatter. Other bare Date fields remain unresolved.
prevention: Retain semantic section context separately from field labels and radio grouping. Test conditional self-ID fields with realistic sibling heading structure and verify actual committed date text. Local browser validation does not establish live application acceptance.
